entries.en: Gerolt has reluctantly agreed to lend his expertise to the restoration of a legendary arm of yore. For the first step, the weaponsmith bids you venture within U'Ghamaro Mines in outer La Noscea to retrieve a lost Bravura. Search for a vessel in which the valuable relic might be kept.

entries.en: Using the alumina salts you brought him, Gerolt adds the finishing touches to your relic weapon. Even as he declares his work over, however, the man believes that there is still something incomplete about it. In order to shed light upon the mystery, Gerolt suggests that you seek out literature surrounding the hero associated with the relic. Perhaps the trader Rowena back at Revenant's Toll will be able to assist you in this endeavor.

entries.en: After a cursory examination of the text, Gerolt declares that he will require some time to make sense of its contents. In the meantime, you are to familiarize yourself with the restored weapon in its current state. Arm yourself with the unfinished Bravura, make your way to U'Ghamaro Mines in outer La Noscea, and there slay eight U'Ghamaro quarrymen, eight U'Ghamaro roundsmen, and eight U'Ghamaro bedesmen.

entries.en:
Upon your return, Gerolt deduces that you must face mightier adversaries if you are to experience a revelation pertaining to your relic. To this end, he bids you challenge the hydra within Halatali, the abandoned training grounds situated in eastern Thanalan. Armed with the unfinished Bravura, enter Halatali and defeat the hydra.

※The hydra can be confronted via the Duty Finder upon examining the quest destination.

entries.en: Jus' let me make one thing clear: it might be as I'm repairin' kettles to pay for yesterday's mead, but I still got me pride as a master weaponsmith. Ye'll get no less than the finest out of me forge.

entries.fr: J'suis pas du genre à faire les choses à moitié, compris<nbsp>? Restaurer des armes antiques, c'est du boulot et va falloir te démener pour m'rapporter tout le nécessaire.
entries.ja:

テメェにも、材料集めだなンだで、働いてもらうからな。

entries.en: There's jus' one snag: the only blacksmith clan what knew how to forge Bravura died out years ago. The last of 'em didn't quite get 'round to trainin' a successor, see, an' the hapless sod took the techniques to his grave.
entries.fr: Le problème, c'est qu'les seules personnes capables d'en fabriquer sont les forgerons du village des guerriers. Et comme y en a plus un seul en vie aujourd'hui, c'est devenu quasi impossible d'en trouver une.
entries.ja:
だが、戦士の里で鍛冶場を仕切っていた
一門が途絶えたことで、その製法は失われちまったと聞く。
「」が、今や「幻の戦斧」と呼ばれる所以よ。

entries.fr: Tu peux toujours demander à celui qui t'a appris les techniques de guerrier de t'filer la sienne, mais ça m'étonnerait qu'il soit assez con pour le faire.

entries.en: Anyroad, if yer to have any hope of gettin' a Bravura to call yer own, it'd be through the kobolds. The creatures're renowned for their skill at the forge, an' it jus' so happens they also have a penchant for scourin' ancient ruins an' mines for artifacts, precious ores, an' the like.
entries.fr: Si tu veux tout savoir, ta seule chance, c'est les Kobolds. Ces créatures apprécient autant creuser des tunnels que forger des armes, et elles aiment par-dessus tout ratisser de fond en comble des ruines pour trouver des reliques ou des minerais rares.
entries.ja:
可能性があるとすりゃ、コボルド族だな。
冶金術に優れるヤツらは、エオルゼア中から古い遺物や
特殊な鉱物を集め、精製法を研究しているンだ。
